description:
Fetch a web page and return its title and main content as Markdown.

Use it to read a specific page in full: a URL the user gave you, or a promising result from web_search whose snippet was not enough. Only http and https URLs are supported. Pages may be served from a shared cache; set refresh to read the live page (billed at the full rate) when the page changes often or the cached copy looks stale.

refresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch the live page (full price); the result replaces the cached copy. Default false.

url.description: The http or https URL of the page to read.

name: web_fetch
title: Fetch web page
